# netbox_vrfs (Data Source)

Retrieves all vrfs from NetBox. Narrow the result with filter blocks and cap it with limit.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_vrfs" "example" {
  filter {
    name  = "name"
    value = "cust-a-prod"
  }
}

output "vrfs" {
  value = data.netbox_vrfs.example.vrfs
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Block Set) Filters that select which items are returned. Each filter is a name/value pair. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 0, which returns all items.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `vrfs` (Attributes List) The VRFs found. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vrfs))

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) The name of the field to filter by.
- `value` (String) The value of the field to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--vrfs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vrfs`

Read-Only:

- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the VRFs.
- `created` (String) When the VRFs was created.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the VRFs, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the vrfs.
- `enforce_unique` (Boolean) The enforce unique of the VRFs.
- `export_targets` (List of Number) The IDs of the export targets of the VRFs.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the vrfs.
- `import_targets` (List of Number) The IDs of the import targets of the VRFs.
- `ipaddress_count` (Number) The number of ipaddress of the VRFs.
- `last_updated` (String) When the VRFs was last changed.
- `name` (String) The name of the vrfs.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the VRFs.
- `prefix_count` (Number) The number of prefix of the VRFs.
- `rd` (String) The route distinguisher of the vrfs.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
- `tenant` (Number) The tenant of the vrfs.
